name: HY-Motion: B_ React_Cover. Cease walking. Immediately transition into a rapid sprint from the walking stance, with the left arm swinging dynamically to provide momentum. Perform a sharp lateral stop and drop into a single-knee kneeling position. The right hand brings the pistol up to a chest-high ready position while moving behind cover (e.g., pillar). The left hand quickly reaches out to touch or press against the cover/pillar to assist with the abrupt deceleration and stabilize the crouching stance.
